name: not_commute_copy_write
doc:
**`copy` 与 `write` 在目标重合时不交换**（反例，承重）：
若 `copy i j`（把 `j` 写到 `i`）与 `write i v`（写常量到 `i`）复合，
两者顺序给出不同结果（`j` 的原值 vs 常量 `v`），故不交换 —— **除非**
`j` 的值恰好等于 `v`（那才是可交换的特例）。
stmt:
theorem not_commute_copy_write {i j : ℕ} {v : ℤ} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ¬ Commute (copyVar i j) (write i v)
proof:
by
  intro h
                              
                                                            
                                                 
                             
  let σ : State := fun x => if x = j then v + 1 else 0
  have hji : j ≠ i := hij.symm
                                      
  have hc := congrFun (congrFun h σ) i
                                                                
                                                                             
                                     
                        
                       
                                                   
                                                                            
                                                                          
                                                                 
                                                                           
  have hleft : (copyVar i j (write i v σ)) i = σ j := by
    show (Function.update (Function.update σ i v) i ((Function.update σ i v) j)) i = σ j
    rw [Function.update_same, Function.update_apply, if_neg hji]
  have hright : (write i v (copyVar i j σ)) i = v := by
    show (Function.update (Function.update σ i (σ j)) i v) i = v
    rw [Function.update_same]

name: not_commute_read_write
doc:
**读-写不交换（简化形式）**：`write` 会**破坏** `copy` 读取的原值，
故读-写对是效应重排的**障碍**。这条与 `commute_write_write` 形成对照：
**写-写（不相交）可换，读-写（相交）不可换**。
stmt:
theorem not_commute_read_write {i : ℕ} {v w : ℤ} (hvw : v ≠ w) :
    ¬ Commute (write i v) (write i w)
proof:
by
  intro h
  have hc := congrFun h (fun _ => (0 : ℤ))
                                                                         
                                                  
  have hci : Function.update (Function.update (fun _ => (0 : ℤ)) i w) i v i
      = Function.update (Function.update (fun _ => (0 : ℤ)) i v) i w i := congrFun hc i
  have h1 : Function.update (Function.update (fun _ => (0 : ℤ)) i w) i v i = v := by
    simp [Function.update]
  have h2 : Function.update (Function.update (fun _ => (0 : ℤ)) i v) i w i = w := by
    simp [Function.update]
  rw [h1, h2] at hci
  exact hvw hci

name: fin_zero_ne_one
doc:
**`n ≥ 2` 时 `0 ≠ 1`**（辅助）：`Fin n` 中两个不同元素。
注意 `0`/`1` 在 `Fin n` 上**不是** `OfNat` 实例（`Fin n` 无 `OfNat (Fin n) 0` 实例，
除非 `n` 已知非零）⟹ 必须写 **`⟨0, _⟩` / `⟨1, _⟩`** 或先 `haveI : NeZero n`。
stmt: lemma fin_zero_ne_one {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin n) ≠ ⟨1, by omega⟩
proof:
by
  intro h
  have hval := congrArg Fin.val h
  simp at hval

name: reorder_count_strict
doc:
**交换约束确实减少合法调度**（承重，序论结论）：
在 `n ≥ 2` 个效应中固定一个效应「必须最先」——这在物理上对应
「存在一个不可交换的效应，它不能与任何东西换到后面」。
则合法顺序集合 `S` 是全体排列 `T` 的**真子集**，故 `#S < #T`。
证明的两个承重点：真子集用 `swap 0 1` 作为不在 `S` 中的见证；
严格小于用 `Finset.card_lt_card` 配合已证的 `⊂`。
stmt:
theorem reorder_count_strict {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∃ (S T : Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))), S ⊂ T ∧ S.card < T.card
proof:
by
                                                                          
                                                                          
                                              
  haveI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  set S : Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :=
    Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) => σ 0 = 0) with hS
  set T : Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) := Finset.univ with hT
  have hsub : S ⊆ T := by
    intro x hx; rw [hT]; exact Finset.mem_univ x
  have hne : S ≠ T := by
    intro heq
    have hmem : Equiv.swap (0 : Fin n) 1 ∈ S := by
      rw [heq, hT]; exact Finset.mem_univ _
    rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter] at hmem
                                                           
                                               
                                                                                              
                                                                           
                                                                 
                                                    
    have h10 : (1 : Fin n) = 0 := by
      have h := hmem.2
      rwa [Equiv.swap_apply_left] at h

name: sat_bot
doc: 假的求值恒为 `false`。
stmt:
@[simp] theorem sat_bot {n : ℕ} (S : FinStruct n) (σ : ℕ → Fin n) :
    Sat S σ .bot = false
proof: rfl

name: sat_imp
doc: 蕴含的语义：`!φ || ψ = true ↔ (φ = true → ψ = true)`。
stmt:
theorem sat_imp {n : ℕ} (S : FinStruct n) (σ : ℕ → Fin n) (φ ψ : Formula) :
    Sat S σ (.imp φ ψ) = true ↔ (Sat S σ φ = true → Sat S σ ψ = true)
proof:
by
  by_cases hφ : Sat S σ φ = true <;> by_cases hψ : Sat S σ ψ = true <;>
    simp [Sat, hφ, hψ]

name: sat_all
doc: 全称的语义：有限域上对所有载体元素逐点测试。
stmt:
theorem sat_all {n : ℕ} (S : FinStruct n) (σ : ℕ → Fin n) (k : ℕ) (φ : Formula) :
    Sat S σ (.all k φ) = true ↔
      ∀ a : Fin n, Sat S (Function.update σ k a) φ = true
proof:
by
  simp only [Sat]
  rw [List.all_eq_true]
  exact ⟨fun h a => h a (List.mem_finRange a), fun h a _ => h a⟩

name: sat_not
doc: `¬φ`（编码为 `φ → ⊥`）的语义。
stmt:
theorem sat_not {n : ℕ} (S : FinStruct n) (σ : ℕ → Fin n) (φ : Formula) :
    Sat S σ (.imp φ .bot) = true ↔ ¬ Sat S σ φ = true
proof:
by
  rw [sat_imp]
  constructor
  · intro h hφ; exact absurd (h hφ) (by simp [Sat])
  · intro h hφ; exact absurd hφ h

name: sat_ex
doc: 存在的语义：有限域上有某个载体元素使 `φ` 成立。
stmt:
theorem sat_ex {n : ℕ} (S : FinStruct n) (σ : ℕ → Fin n) (k : ℕ) (φ : Formula) :
    Sat S σ (ex k φ) = true ↔
      ∃ a : Fin n, Sat S (Function.update σ k a) φ = true
proof:
by
  unfold ex
  rw [sat_not, sat_all]
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    exact h (fun a => (sat_not S (Function.update σ k a) φ).2 (hc a))
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩ hall
    exact (sat_not S (Function.update σ k a) φ).1 (hall a) ha

name: sat_eq_refl
doc: 等式自反：`⊨ t = t`（任何结构、任何赋值）。
stmt:
theorem sat_eq_refl {n : ℕ} (S : FinStruct n) (σ : ℕ → Fin n) (t : FOTerm) :
    Sat S σ (.eq t t) = true
proof:
by
  simp [Sat]

name: validOnFinite_iff
doc: **有限域对应**：`φ` 在所有有限模型上有效 ⟺ 每个有限结构都满足 `φ`。
stmt:
theorem validOnFinite_iff (φ : Formula) :
    ValidOnFinite φ ↔ ∀ (n : ℕ) (S : FinStruct n), Holds S φ
proof: Iff.rfl

name: holds_iff
doc: `Holds` 的定义展开。
stmt:
theorem holds_iff {n : ℕ} (S : FinStruct n) (φ : Formula) :
    Holds S φ ↔ ∀ σ, Sat S σ φ = true
proof: Iff.rfl

name: entails_nil
doc: 空理论的可导出性就是有限域有效性。
stmt: theorem entails_nil (φ : Formula) : EntailsFO [] φ ↔ ValidOnFinite φ
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h n S σ; exact h n S σ (by simp)
  · intro h n S σ _; exact h n S σ

name: valid_eq_refl
doc: 等式自反在所有有限模型上有效。
stmt: theorem valid_eq_refl : ValidOnFinite (.eq (.var 0) (.var 0))
proof:
by
  intro n S σ
  exact sat_eq_refl S σ _

name: hasModel_iff
doc: `HasModel` 的定义展开。
stmt:
theorem hasModel_iff (T : List Formula) :
    HasModel T ↔ ∃ (n : ℕ) (S : FinStruct n) (σ : ℕ → Fin n),
      ∀ ψ ∈ T, Sat S σ ψ = true
proof: Iff.rfl

name: S2_all_atom_false
doc: **具体见证**：在 `S2` 上 `∀x. P(x)` 不成立（元素 1 不满足 `P`）。
stmt:
theorem S2_all_atom_false :
    Sat S2 (fun _ => (0 : Fin 2)) (.all 0 (.atom 0 [.var 0])) = false
proof:
by
  decide

name: S2_ex_atom_true
doc: **具体见证（存在）**：在 `S2` 上 `∃x. P(x)` 成立（元素 0 满足 `P`）。
stmt:
theorem S2_ex_atom_true :
    Sat S2 (fun _ => (1 : Fin 2)) (ex 0 (.atom 0 [.var 0])) = true
proof:
by
  decide

name: hasAtLeast_iff_le
doc: **载体基数刻画**：`HasAtLeast m S ↔ m ≤ n`（载体 `Fin n`）。
stmt:
theorem hasAtLeast_iff_le (m : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (S : FinStruct n) :
    HasAtLeast m S ↔ m ≤ n
proof: Iff.rfl

name: card_fin
doc: **`Fin n` 的基数**（把 `HasAtLeast` 与单射存在性联系起来的桥梁）。
stmt: theorem card_fin (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Fin n) = n
proof: Fintype.card_fin n

name: hasAtLeast_iff_exists_injective
doc:
**「至少 `m` 个元素」⟺ 存在单射 `Fin m ↪ Fin n`**：
这是「`m` 个两两不等的元素」的**精确**集合论内容，
也是把语义谓词 `HasAtLeast` 与一阶公式
`∃x_0…∃x_{m-1}. ⋀ x_i ≠ x_j` 联系起来的那一步。
stmt:
theorem hasAtLeast_iff_exists_injective {m n : ℕ} :
    m ≤ n ↔ ∃ f : Fin m → Fin n, Function.Injective f
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun i => ⟨i.1, by omega⟩, fun i j hij => Fin.ext (by simpa using congrArg Fin.val hij)⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    have := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
    simpa [card_fin] using this

name: not_injective_of_lt
doc:
**鸽巢引理（机器验证）**：`n < m` 时不存在 `Fin m → Fin n` 的单射
——即 `Fin n` 装不下 `m` 个互异元素。这是「整族无有限模型」的**技术核心**。
stmt:
theorem not_injective_of_lt {n m : ℕ} (h : n < m) :
    ¬ ∃ f : Fin m → Fin n, Function.Injective f
proof:
by
  rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
  have := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  simp [card_fin] at this
  omega

name: families_satisfiable
doc:
**每个成员都有有限模型**：`families m` 在载体 `Fin m` 上成立
（`families m n S` 就是 `m ≤ n`，故具体解释无关）。

**说明**：要求 `0 < m`，因为 `Fin 0` 是空类型，无法构造 `FinStruct 0`
的常量/函数解释（`constVal : ℕ → Fin 0` 无居民）。
对紧致性反例只需**任意大**的 `m`，故 `0 < m` 的版本完全够用。
stmt:
theorem families_satisfiable {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (S : FinStruct n), families m n S
proof:
by
  refine ⟨m, ?_, le_rfl⟩
  exact ⟨fun _ => ⟨0, hm⟩, fun _ _ => ⟨0, hm⟩, fun _ _ => false⟩

name: finite_subset_satisfiable
doc: **有穷子集可满足**：单元素有穷子集 `{families m}`（`m > 0`）在有限域上可满足。
stmt:
theorem finite_subset_satisfiable {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (S : FinStruct n), families m n S
proof: families_satisfiable hm

name: no_finite_model_for_all
doc:
**整族没有有限模型（核心反例）**：不存在有限结构使**所有** `families m` 同时成立
——因为载体 `Fin n` 至多容纳 `n` 个元素，而 `families (n+1)` 要求至少 `n+1` 个。
stmt:
theorem no_finite_model_for_all :
    ¬ ∃ (n : ℕ) (S : FinStruct n), ∀ m : ℕ, families m n S
proof:
by
  rintro ⟨n, S, h⟩
                                                                    
  have h1 : n + 1 ≤ n := h (n + 1)
  omega

name: finite_domain_compactness_fails
doc:
**有限域紧致性为假（Trakhtenbrot 方向）**：存在一个公式族，其**每个**成员
（从而每个有穷子集）在有限域上可满足，但**整族**在有限域上不可满足。
stmt:
theorem finite_domain_compactness_fails :
    ∃ T : ℕ → ∀ n, FinStruct n → Prop,
      (∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → ∃ (n : ℕ) (S : FinStruct n), T m n S) ∧
        ¬ ∃ (n : ℕ) (S : FinStruct n), ∀ m : ℕ, T m n S
proof: ⟨families, fun _ hm => finite_subset_satisfiable hm, no_finite_model_for_all⟩

name: finite_domain_compactness_hypothesis_false
doc:
**「有穷可满足 ⟹ 可满足」在有限域语义下为假**：
这是紧致性定理（一般语义）在**有限域限制**下的失败，机器验证形式。
stmt:
theorem finite_domain_compactness_hypothesis_false :
    ¬ (∀ T : ℕ → ∀ n, FinStruct n → Prop,
        (∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → ∃ (n : ℕ) (S : FinStruct n), T m n S) →
          ∃ (n : ℕ) (S : FinStruct n), ∀ m : ℕ, T m n S)
proof:
by
  intro hcomp
  obtain ⟨T, hfin, hall⟩ := finite_domain_compactness_fails
  exact hall (hcomp T hfin)

name: families_two_fails_on_fin_one
doc:
**具体见证（最小实例，机器验证）**：`families 2` 在载体 `Fin 1` 上**不成立**
（一个元素装不下两个）。
stmt: theorem families_two_fails_on_fin_one (S : FinStruct 1) : ¬ families 2 1 S
proof:
by
  show ¬ (2 ≤ 1)
  omega

name: dropDB_liftDB
doc:
**往返恒等（`drop ∘ lift = id`）**：`dropDB c (liftDB c φ) = φ`。
这是 `liftDB`/`dropDB` 互逆的**无条件**方向（对任意公式、任意 `c` 成立）。
证明对 `φ` 归纳，`allDB` 分支用 `c + 1` 处的结论（广义归纳）。

**STYLE 陷阱（本轮实测）**：`liftDB`/`dropDB` 是模式匹配 `def`，
`rw [if_pos h]` 在目标仍是 `dropDB c (bvar k)` 时报
`did not find instance of the pattern if …`——必须先用
`simp only [liftDB, dropDB]` 展开定义（同时完成 `if` 的化简），再处理算术。
stmt:
theorem dropDB_liftDB (φ : DBFormula) :
    ∀ c : ℕ, dropDB c (liftDB c φ) = φ
proof:
by
  induction φ with
  | bvar k =>
      intro c
      by_cases h : k < c
      ·                                               
        simp only [liftDB, dropDB, if_pos h, if_pos (show k ≤ c by omega)]
      ·                                                
                                                                     
                                                                        
        simp only [liftDB, dropDB, if_neg h, if_neg (show ¬ k + 1 ≤ c by omega)]
        rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  | atomDB r => intro c; rfl
  | bot => intro c; rfl
  | imp φ ψ ihφ ihψ => intro c; simp only [liftDB, dropDB, ihφ c, ihψ c]
  | allDB φ ih => intro c; simp only [liftDB, dropDB, ih (c + 1)]

name: liftDB_bvar_lt
doc:
**`liftDB` 保持「已绑定」层**：`k < c` 时 `liftDB c` 不动 `bvar k`
（「提升」只作用于自由变量）。
stmt: theorem liftDB_bvar_lt {c k : ℕ} (h : k < c) : liftDB c (.bvar k) = .bvar k
proof:
by
  simp only [liftDB, if_pos h]

name: liftDB_bvar_ge
doc: **`liftDB` 提升自由变量**：`c ≤ k` 时 `liftDB c (bvar k) = bvar (k+1)`。
stmt: theorem liftDB_bvar_ge {c k : ℕ} (h : c ≤ k) : liftDB c (.bvar k) = .bvar (k + 1)
proof:
by
  simp only [liftDB, if_neg (show ¬ k < c by omega)]

name: dbSat_allDB
doc:
**`allDB` 的语义**：`dbSat S η (allDB φ)` 是对全载体的有限合取，
且新绑定的元素被压到**栈头**（这正是 de Bruijn「最近绑定在最外层」的编码）。
stmt:
theorem dbSat_allDB {n : ℕ} (S : FinStruct n) (η : List (Fin n)) (φ : DBFormula) :
    dbSat S η (.allDB φ) = true ↔
      ∀ a : Fin n, dbSat S (a :: η) φ = true
proof:
by
  simp only [dbSat]
  rw [List.all_eq_true]
  exact ⟨fun h a => h a (List.mem_finRange a), fun h a _ => h a⟩

name: dbSat_bvar_zero
doc: **`bvar 0` 取栈头**：最近绑定的变量在栈头（辅助引理）。
stmt:
theorem dbSat_bvar_zero {n : ℕ} (S : FinStruct n) (a : Fin n) (η : List (Fin n)) :
    dbSat S (a :: η) (.bvar 0) = true
proof:
by
  simp [dbSat]

name: dbSat_liftBvar
doc:
**提升引理（`bvar` 层）**：`bvar (k+1)` 在 `c :: η` 下与 `bvar k` 在 `η` 下
**指向同一元素**——这正是 de Bruijn「压栈 ↔ 索引加一」相容性在变量层的
机器验证，也是 `liftDB` 设计的正确性依据。
stmt:
theorem dbSat_liftBvar {n : ℕ} (S : FinStruct n) (c : Fin n) (η : List (Fin n))
    (k : ℕ) : dbSat S (c :: η) (.bvar (k + 1)) = dbSat S η (.bvar k)
proof:
by
  simp only [dbSat, List.getElem?_cons_succ]

name: ofDB_toDB
doc:
**往返恒等（具名 → de Bruijn → 具名）**：
若 `toDB φ = some ψ`，则 `ofDB ψ = φ`。
（`toDB φ = some ψ` 精确刻画了互译成功的片段：
0 元原子 + 假 + 蕴含。）
stmt: theorem ofDB_toDB (φ : Formula) : ∀ ψ : DBFormula, toDB φ = some ψ → ofDB ψ = φ
proof:
by
  induction φ with
  | atom r args =>
      intro ψ h
      match args with
      | [] =>
          simp only [toDB, Option.some.injEq] at h
          rw [← h]
          rfl
      | _ :: _ => simp [toDB] at h
  | eq s t => intro ψ h; simp [toDB] at h
  | bot =>
      intro ψ h
      simp only [toDB, Option.some.injEq] at h
      rw [← h]
      rfl
  | imp φ ψ ihφ ihψ =>
      intro χ h
      simp only [toDB] at h
      cases hφ : toDB φ with
      | none => simp [hφ] at h
      | some a =>
          cases hψ : toDB ψ with
          | none => simp [hφ, hψ] at h
          | some b =>
              simp only [hφ, hψ, Option.some.injEq] at h
              rw [← h]
              simp only [ofDB, ihφ a hφ, ihψ b hψ]
  | all k φ ih =>
                                                   
      intro ψ h
      exact absurd h (by simp [toDB])

name: toDB_ne_none_of_free
doc: **`IsFree0` ⟹ 互译成功**：`toDB φ ≠ none`——把适用范围**机器可查**地圈出。
stmt: theorem toDB_ne_none_of_free {φ : Formula} (h : IsFree0 φ) : toDB φ ≠ none
proof:
by
  induction φ with
  | atom r args =>
      simp only [IsFree0] at h
      subst h
      simp [toDB]
  | eq s t => simp only [IsFree0] at h
  | bot => simp [toDB]
  | imp φ ψ ihφ ihψ =>
      obtain ⟨hφ, hψ⟩ := h
      have h1 := ihφ hφ
      have h2 := ihψ hψ
      cases ha : toDB φ with
      | none => exact absurd ha h1
      | some a =>
          cases hb : toDB ψ with
          | none => exact absurd hb h2
          | some b => simp [toDB, ha, hb]
  | all k φ ih => simp only [IsFree0] at h

name: toDB_eq_none_of_all
doc: **含 `all` ⟹ 互译失败**：`toDB (.all k ψ) = none`。
stmt: theorem toDB_eq_none_of_all (k : ℕ) (ψ : Formula) : toDB (.all k ψ) = none
proof: rfl

name: ofDB_toDB_witness
doc: **具体见证（无量词往返）**：`⊥ → ⊥` 在互译片段内，往返还原。
stmt: theorem ofDB_toDB_witness : ofDB (.imp .bot .bot) = (.imp .bot .bot : Formula)
proof:
ofDB_toDB _ _ rfl

end Lattice.Lib.Compiler.RealFirstOrderLogic

name: joinable_refl
doc: 汇合的自反性。
stmt: theorem joinable_refl (r : α → α → Prop) (a : α) : Joinable r a a
proof: ⟨a, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩

name: joinable_symm
doc:
汇合的对称性。
（`Joinable` 是 `∃` 的 `def` 别名，点号投影 `.1`/`.2` 会失败——STYLE 速查表
「`ConvexOn` 等是 `def` 别名」同类坑，故这里先 `obtain` 再重组。）
stmt:
theorem joinable_symm {r : α → α → Prop} {a b : α} (h : Joinable r a b) :
    Joinable r b a
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨d, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  exact ⟨d, h₂, h₁⟩

name: star_single
doc: 单步可推出多步。
stmt:
theorem star_single {r : α → α → Prop} {a b : α} (h : r a b) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen r a b
proof: Relation.ReflTransGen.single h

name: star_trans
doc: 多步可推出多步。
stmt:
theorem star_trans {r : α → α → Prop} {a b c : α} (h₁ : Relation.ReflTransGen r a b)
    (h₂ : Relation.ReflTransGen r b c) : Relation.ReflTransGen r a c
proof: h₁.trans h₂

name: confluent_of_wf
doc:
**Newman 引理核心**：终止 + 局部合流 ⟹ 合流。
证明对起点做良基归纳：把两个归约序列各拆出首步（`cases_head`），
用局部合流得到中间汇合点，再对两个首步的后继分别用归纳假设合并。
stmt:
theorem confluent_of_wf {r : α → α → Prop} (hT : Terminating r)
    (hL : LocallyConfluent r) : Confluent r
proof:
by
                                                                        
                                                      
                                         
  intro a
  refine hT.induction (C := fun x => ∀ b c : α,
    Relation.ReflTransGen r x b → Relation.ReflTransGen r x c → Joinable r b c) a ?_
  intro x ih b c hab hac
  rcases hab.cases_head with hb | ⟨b₁, hab₁, hb₁b⟩
  · rw [← hb]
    exact ⟨c, hac, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
  rcases hac.cases_head with hc | ⟨c₁, hac₁, hc₁c⟩
  · rw [← hc]
    exact ⟨b, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, hab⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hb₁d, hc₁d⟩ := hL x b₁ c₁ hab₁ hac₁
  obtain ⟨e, hbe, hde⟩ := ih b₁ hab₁ b d hb₁b hb₁d
  obtain ⟨f, hcf, hef⟩ := ih c₁ hac₁ c e hc₁c (hc₁d.trans hde)
  exact ⟨f, hbe.trans hef, hcf⟩

name: newman
doc: **Newman 引理**：终止 + 局部合流 ⟹ 合流。
stmt:
theorem newman {r : α → α → Prop} (hT : Terminating r) (hL : LocallyConfluent r) :
    Confluent r
proof: confluent_of_wf hT hL

name: confluent_normalForm_unique
doc: **合流 ⟹ 规范形唯一**：若 `a` 归约到两个规范形，则它们相等。
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨d, hd₁, hd₂⟩ := hC a n₁ n₂ h₁ h₂
  rcases hd₁.cases_head with h | ⟨e, he, _⟩
  · rcases hd₂.cases_head with h' | ⟨e', he', _⟩
    · exact h.trans h'.symm
    · exact absurd ⟨e', he'⟩ hn₂
  · exact absurd ⟨e, he⟩ hn₁

name: prec_terminating
doc:
`prec` 终止（每步严格减小，用强归纳证明可及性）。
`WellFounded` 是 **inductive**（构造子 `WellFounded.intro : (∀ a, Acc r a) → WellFounded r`），
不是 `def` 别名，故 `intro n` 因无绑定子而报 "insufficient number of binders"
——必须先 `refine WellFounded.intro ?_` 拆开构造子。
stmt: theorem prec_terminating : Terminating prec
proof:
by
  refine WellFounded.intro ?_
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih => exact Acc.intro n (fun m h => ih m (by unfold prec at h; omega))

name: prec_locallyConfluent
doc: `prec` 局部合流（确定性：`b + 1 = c + 1 ⟹ b = c`）。
stmt: theorem prec_locallyConfluent : LocallyConfluent prec
proof:
by
  intro a b c hab hac
  unfold prec at hab hac
  have hbc : b = c := by omega
  subst hbc
  exact ⟨b, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩

name: prec_confluent
doc: `prec` 合流（无条件应用 Newman 引理）。
stmt: theorem prec_confluent : Confluent prec
proof:
newman prec_terminating prec_locallyConfluent

end Lattice

name: upRen_id
doc: 重命名恒等函数保持不变。
stmt: theorem upRen_id : upRen id = id
proof:
by
  funext n
  cases n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m => simp [upRen]

name: upRen_comp
doc: 重命名提升与函数复合相容。
stmt: theorem upRen_comp (ρ ρ' : ℕ → ℕ) : upRen (ρ ∘ ρ') = upRen ρ ∘ upRen ρ'
proof:
by
  funext n
  cases n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m => simp [upRen, Function.comp]

name: ren_id
doc: 恒等重命名不改变项。
stmt: theorem ren_id (t : Term) : ren id t = t
proof:
by
  induction t with
  | var n => rfl
  | lam t ih => simp only [ren, upRen_id, ih]
  | app a b iha ihb => simp only [ren, iha, ihb]

name: ren_ren
doc: 重命名的复合律：`ren ρ (ren ρ' t) = ren (ρ ∘ ρ') t`。
stmt:
theorem ren_ren (t : Term) (ρ ρ' : ℕ → ℕ) :
    ren ρ (ren ρ' t) = ren (ρ ∘ ρ') t
proof:
by
  induction t generalizing ρ ρ' with
  | var n => rfl
  | lam t ih =>
      simp only [ren]
      rw [ih (upRen ρ) (upRen ρ'), upRen_comp]
  | app a b iha ihb => simp only [ren, iha ρ ρ', ihb ρ ρ']

name: lift_zero
doc: 提升 0 步等于恒等。
stmt: theorem lift_zero (t : Term) : lift 0 t = t
proof:
by
  unfold lift
  have h : (fun m : ℕ => m + 0) = id := by funext m; rfl
  rw [h, ren_id]

name: lift_zero_id
doc: `lift 0 = id`（函数等式形式）。
stmt: theorem lift_zero_id : lift 0 = id
proof:
by
  funext t
  exact lift_zero t

name: lift_lift
doc: 提升的复合律：`lift n (lift m t) = lift (n + m) t`。
stmt: theorem lift_lift (t : Term) (n m : ℕ) : lift n (lift m t) = lift (n + m) t
proof:
by
  unfold lift
  rw [ren_ren]
  apply congrArg (fun ρ => ren ρ t)
  funext k
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  omega

name: up_ext
doc: `up` 对逐点相等的替换保持逐点相等。
stmt: theorem up_ext {σ τ : ℕ → Term} (h : ∀ n, σ n = τ n) : ∀ n, up σ n = up τ n
proof:
by
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m => simp only [up]; rw [h m]

name: subst_ext
doc: 替换对逐点相等的替换函数保持相等（外延性）。
stmt:
theorem subst_ext (t : Term) {σ τ : ℕ → Term} (h : ∀ n, σ n = τ n) :
    subst σ t = subst τ t
proof:
by
  induction t generalizing σ τ with
  | var n => exact h n
  | lam t ih => simp only [subst]; rw [ih (up_ext h)]
  | app a b iha ihb => simp only [subst, iha h, ihb h]

name: ren_subst
doc: 重命名与替换可交换：`ren ρ (subst σ t) = subst (fun n => ren ρ (σ n)) t`。
stmt:
theorem ren_subst (t : Term) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) (σ : ℕ → Term) :
    ren ρ (subst σ t) = subst (fun n => ren ρ (σ n)) t
proof:
by
  induction t generalizing ρ σ with
  | var n => rfl
  | lam t ih =>
      simp only [subst, ren]
      rw [ih (upRen ρ) (up σ)]
      congr 1
      apply subst_ext
      intro n
      cases n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ m =>
          simp only [up, lift]
          rw [ren_ren, ren_ren]
          congr 1
  | app a b iha ihb => simp only [subst, ren, iha ρ σ, ihb ρ σ]

name: subst_ren
doc: 替换与重命名可交换：`subst σ (ren ρ t) = subst (fun n => σ (ρ n)) t`。
stmt:
theorem subst_ren (t : Term) (σ : ℕ → Term) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) :
    subst σ (ren ρ t) = subst (fun n => σ (ρ n)) t
proof:
by
  induction t generalizing σ ρ with
  | var n => rfl
  | lam t ih =>
      simp only [subst, ren]
      rw [ih (up σ) (upRen ρ)]
      congr 1
      apply subst_ext
      intro n
      cases n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ m => simp only [up, upRen]
  | app a b iha ihb => simp only [subst, ren, iha σ ρ, ihb σ ρ]

name: up_var
doc: `up` 保持替换恒等函数：`up var = var`。
stmt: theorem up_var : up (Term.var) = Term.var
proof:
by
  funext n
  cases n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m => simp [up, lift, ren]

name: subst_id
doc: 用变量替换恒等：`subst var t = t`。
stmt: theorem subst_id (t : Term) : subst Term.var t = t
proof:
by
  induction t with
  | var n => rfl
  | lam t ih => simp only [subst]; rw [up_var, ih]
  | app a b iha ihb => simp only [subst, iha, ihb]

name: upRen_idBelow
doc: `upRen` 保持「在 `< c` 上恒等」。
stmt:
theorem upRen_idBelow {c : ℕ} {ρ : ℕ → ℕ} (h : RenamingIdBelow c ρ) :
    RenamingIdBelow (c + 1) (upRen ρ)
proof:
by
  intro m hm
  cases m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k =>
      simp only [upRen]
      rw [h k (by omega)]

name: closed_ren
doc: **闭项在恒等重命名下不变**。
stmt:
theorem closed_ren (t : Term) (c : ℕ) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) (h : RenamingIdBelow c ρ)
    (hc : ClosedAt c t) : ren ρ t = t
proof:
by
  induction t generalizing c ρ with
  | var n => simp only [ren]; rw [h n hc]
  | lam t ih =>
      simp only [ren]
      rw [ih (c + 1) (upRen ρ) (upRen_idBelow h) (show ClosedAt (c + 1) t from hc)]
  | app a b iha ihb =>
      simp only [ren]
      rw [iha c ρ h hc.1, ihb c ρ h hc.2]

name: closed_lift
doc: **闭项在提升下不变**：`Closed t ⟹ lift n t = t`。
stmt: theorem closed_lift (t : Term) (n : ℕ) (h : Closed t) : lift n t = t
proof:
by
  have hr : RenamingIdBelow 0 (fun m => m + n) := by intro m hm; omega
  exact closed_ren t 0 (fun m => m + n) hr h

name: up_isIdBelow
doc: `up` 保持「在 `< c` 上是变量本身」。
stmt:
theorem up_isIdBelow {c : ℕ} {σ : ℕ → Term} (h : IsIdBelow c σ) :
    IsIdBelow (c + 1) (up σ)
proof:
by
  intro n hn
  cases n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m =>
      simp only [up]
      rw [h m (by omega)]
      simp [lift, ren]

name: closed_subst_eq
doc:
**闭项在「恒等替换」下不变**：若替换在 `< c` 上是变量本身且 `ClosedAt c t`，
则 `subst σ t = t`。
stmt:
theorem closed_subst_eq (t : Term) (c : ℕ) (σ : ℕ → Term) (h : IsIdBelow c σ)
    (hc : ClosedAt c t) : subst σ t = t
proof:
by
  induction t generalizing c σ with
  | var n => exact h n hc
  | lam t ih =>
      simp only [subst]
      rw [ih (c + 1) (up σ) (up_isIdBelow h) (show ClosedAt (c + 1) t from hc)]
  | app a b iha ihb =>
      simp only [subst]
      rw [iha c σ h hc.1, ihb c σ h hc.2]

end Lattice

name: D1_compile_loses_distance_value
doc:
**降级 D1（Lv-00 声称「编译保持语义」为假）**：
`compile_constraint` 把 `distance [a,b]`（**无载荷**）编译为 `distance a b (const 0)`，
即「a 与 b 重合」。于是**两个不同的点**满足源约束（源侧无约束）却不满足编译产物。
⇒ 同环境方向的语义保持**不成立**。
stmt:
theorem D1_compile_loses_distance_value :
    ¬ ir_sem (fun s => if s = "a" then ((1 : ℝ), 0) else (0, 0)) (.distance "a" "b" (.const 0))
proof:
by
  simp only [ir_sem, eval_expr, dist, ptX, ptY]
  intro h
  have h1 : Real.sqrt ((1 - 0) ^ 2 + ((0 : ℝ) - 0) ^ 2) = 0 := h
  rw [show ((1 : ℝ) - 0) ^ 2 + ((0 : ℝ) - 0) ^ 2 = 1 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_one] at h1
  exact one_ne_zero h1

name: D1_compile_ignores_constraint_name
doc:
**降级 D1'（编译丢弃约束名）**：只需 kind 与 arity 相同，编译结果就完全相同——
源约束的**名字**在编译产物中消失。
proof: rfl

name: D2_bridge_independent_of_source
doc:
**降级 D2'（桥接引理对源程序无信息）**：
退化环境满足**任意**两个点名（甚至不同点）的编译后距离约束——
即 `compile_bridge_sem` 的内容与 `c`、`pts` 完全无关。
stmt:
theorem D2_bridge_independent_of_source (a b : VarName) :
    ir_sem (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) (.distance a b (.const 0))
proof:
by
  simp [ir_sem, dist, eval_expr, ptX]

name: D2_bridge_midpoint_trivial
doc:
**降级 D2''**：退化环境满足**任意点名的任意组合**的中点约束，
说明桥接引理的「证明」实质是「把所有点压到原点」。
stmt:
theorem D2_bridge_midpoint_trivial (m a b : VarName) :
    ir_sem (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) (.midpoint m a b)
proof:
by
  simp [ir_sem, ptX, ptY]

name: D3_angle_compiles_to_tautology
doc:
**降级 D3（`angle` 约束被编译为恒真占位，语义完全丢失）**：
`compile_constraint` 把 `angle` 编译为 `.eq_expr (.const 0) (.const 0)`。
stmt:
theorem D3_angle_compiles_to_tautology (ps : List lvPoint) (a b c d : VarName) :
    compile_constraint ps { name := "A", kind := .angle, args := [a, b, c, d] } =
    some (.eq_expr (.const 0) (.const 0))
proof: rfl

name: D3_angle_placeholder_always_true
doc: **降级 D3'**：上述占位约束在任意环境下为真（「恒真占位」名副其实）。
stmt:
theorem D3_angle_placeholder_always_true (env : String → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ir_sem env (.eq_expr (.const 0) (.const 0))
proof:
by
  simp [ir_sem, eval_expr]

name: D4_eval_expr_ignores_y
doc:
**降级 D4（`IRExpr.var` 只读 x 坐标 ⇒ 表达式层是一维投影）**：
两个 y 坐标不同、x 坐标相同的点在 IR 表达式层**不可区分**——
`IRExpr` 无法表达任何依赖 y 的约束。
stmt:
theorem D4_eval_expr_ignores_y :
    eval_expr (fun s => if s = "p" then ((3 : ℝ), 5) else (0, 0)) (.var "p") =
    eval_expr (fun s => if s = "p" then ((3 : ℝ), 9) else (0, 0)) (.var "p")
proof:
by
  simp [eval_expr, ptX]

name: D4_eval_expr_eq_fst
doc: **降级 D4'**：更强的表述——`eval_expr` 对变量求值**完全不看 y**。
stmt:
theorem D4_eval_expr_eq_fst (env : String → ℝ × ℝ) (v : String) :
    eval_expr env (.var v) = (env v).1
proof: rfl

name: D5_point_env_never_enters_compilation
doc:
**降级 D5（编译是无状态重写，点环境从未进入编译产物）**：
`compile_constraint` 的第一个参数 `_ps` 被下划线标记为**未使用**；
这里机器验证：点列表参数对编译结果**完全无影响**。因此 Lv-00 的「编译」不建立任何
「点名 → 坐标」的绑定，`compile_points`（构造环境）在编译管道中**从未被调用**。
stmt:
theorem D5_point_env_never_enters_compilation (ps : List lvPoint) (c : lvConstraint) :
    compile_constraint ps c = compile_constraint [] c
proof: congrFun (compile_constraint_ps_irrelevant ps []) c

name: D6_tangent_sem_too_weak
doc:
**降级 D6（`tangent` 语义过弱）**：
`ir_sem` 的 `tangent` 只要求直线上**存在一点**落在圆上，
而非「直线与圆相切」（唯一公共点）。在退化环境（圆退化为一个点）下，
**任意**两条直线都「满足」该约束——语义过弱。
stmt:
theorem D6_tangent_sem_too_weak :
    ir_sem (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) (.tangent "o" "p" "l1" "l2")
proof:
⟨0, by simp [ir_sem, dist, ptX, ptY]⟩

end Lattice.Lv00.Compiler

name: empty_graph_satisfiable
doc: 空图恒可满足。`(B)`（证明为构造退化环境 + 空列表消解，平凡但有接口价值）。
stmt: theorem empty_graph_satisfiable : graph_satisfiable []
proof:
⟨fun _ => (0, 0), by intro c hc; simp at hc⟩


end Lattice.Lv00.Compiler

name: compile_empty
doc:
**(B)** 空程序编译为空图。原为 `theorem compile_empty … := rfl`，平凡。
保留作为接口锚点。
stmt: theorem compile_empty : compile_program ([] : lvProgram) = ([] : CompilerConstraintGraph)
proof: rfl

name: compile_stmt_ps_irrelevant
doc: **(A) 语句编译与点列表无关**（对 `compile_constraint_ps_irrelevant` 的分派）。
stmt:
theorem compile_stmt_ps_irrelevant (ps1 ps2 : List lvPoint) (st : lvStmt) :
    compile_stmt st ps1 = compile_stmt st ps2
proof:
by
  unfold compile_stmt
  cases st with
  | point p => rfl
  | constraint c => rw [compile_constraint_ps_irrelevant ps1 ps2]
  | prove => rfl
  | normalize => rfl

name: compile_program_go_ps_irrelevant
doc: **(A) 程序编译与初始点列表无关**：结构归纳，非平凡。
stmt:
theorem compile_program_go_ps_irrelevant (ps1 ps2 : List lvPoint) (prog : lvProgram) :
    compile_program_go ps1 prog = compile_program_go ps2 prog
proof:
by
  induction prog generalizing ps1 ps2 with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons st sts ih =>
      cases st with
      | point p =>
          show compile_stmt (.point p) ps1 ++ compile_program_go (p :: ps1) sts =
               compile_stmt (.point p) ps2 ++ compile_program_go (p :: ps2) sts
          rw [compile_stmt_ps_irrelevant ps1 ps2, ih (p :: ps1) (p :: ps2)]
      | constraint c =>
          show compile_stmt (.constraint c) ps1 ++ compile_program_go ps1 sts =
               compile_stmt (.constraint c) ps2 ++ compile_program_go ps2 sts
          rw [compile_stmt_ps_irrelevant ps1 ps2, ih ps1 ps2]
      | prove =>
          show compile_stmt .prove ps1 ++ compile_program_go ps1 sts =
               compile_stmt .prove ps2 ++ compile_program_go ps2 sts
          rw [compile_stmt_ps_irrelevant ps1 ps2, ih ps1 ps2]
      | normalize =>
          show compile_stmt .normalize ps1 ++ compile_program_go ps1 sts =
               compile_stmt .normalize ps2 ++ compile_program_go ps2 sts
          rw [compile_stmt_ps_irrelevant ps1 ps2, ih ps1 ps2]

name: compile_program_go_append
doc: **(A) `compile_program_go` 对拼接的分配律**（带初始点列表参数）。
stmt:
theorem compile_program_go_append (ps : List lvPoint) (p1 p2 : lvProgram) :
    compile_program_go ps (p1 ++ p2) =
      compile_program_go ps p1 ++ compile_program_go ps p2
proof:
by
  induction p1 generalizing ps with
  | nil => simp [compile_program_go]
  | cons st rest ih =>
      cases st with
      | point p =>
          show compile_stmt (.point p) ps ++ compile_program_go (p :: ps) (rest ++ p2) =
               (compile_stmt (.point p) ps ++ compile_program_go (p :: ps) rest) ++
                 compile_program_go ps p2
          rw [ih (p :: ps), compile_program_go_ps_irrelevant (p :: ps) ps p2]
          simp [List.append_assoc]
      | constraint c =>
          show compile_stmt (.constraint c) ps ++ compile_program_go ps (rest ++ p2) =
               (compile_stmt (.constraint c) ps ++ compile_program_go ps rest) ++
                 compile_program_go ps p2
          rw [ih ps]
          simp [List.append_assoc]
      | prove =>
          show compile_stmt .prove ps ++ compile_program_go ps (rest ++ p2) =
               (compile_stmt .prove ps ++ compile_program_go ps rest) ++ compile_program_go ps p2
          rw [ih ps]
          simp [List.append_assoc]
      | normalize =>
          show compile_stmt .normalize ps ++ compile_program_go ps (rest ++ p2) =
               (compile_stmt .normalize ps ++ compile_program_go ps rest) ++
                 compile_program_go ps p2
          rw [ih ps]
          simp [List.append_assoc]
